overview_description.description: Rune Technologies develops TyrOS, an AI-enabled predictive logistics platform designed for military and contested environments. The platform connects, organizes, and analyzes critical sustainment information, providing real-time data-driven decisions for logistics and sustainment systems. It offers intelligent planning, decision support, and predictive analytics to enhance precision, agility, and efficiency in supply operations.
